svg.title: Current Vaccine Supply Chain System Architecture
svg.desc: Current implemented local demo architecture: synthetic simulator and manual input enter through Mosquitto, edge gateway, Express API and Redis Streams. A separate backend worker runs persistence, approved policy, AI advisory and Merkle anchoring consumer groups. MongoDB, FastAPI, notification outbox and local Hardhat support the role dashboards, field panel, QR verification and approval-only supply planning.
svg.text: Current implemented architecture · local synthetic demo
Role-protected forms preserve actor and source.
Persistence completes first; anchoring also waits for policy commit.
Location, edge flags and event identity
Save score / explanation with the reading
Advisory only · cannot set safety holds
Proof metadata in Mongo; root on Hardhat
Each consumer group uses the service below; MongoDB remains the application query source.
Outbox rows · Merkle leaves and proofs
Primary durable application and query store.
Compose email is Ethereal test capture.
QR check combines chain root + Mongo proof
authorized API reads · live alerts · proof verification
Shipment views, alerts, maps, analytics and reports.
Batch identity and sensor proof are reported separately.
Evidence status: yes · pending · no / mismatch.
Operational order / inventory history is analyzed separately from sensor policy decisions.
Synthetic inputs are not external demand validation. Seed stock can remain ineligible until manufacturing release gates pass.

Prototype boundary: private local Compose traffic, software-generated telemetry and a volatile local Hardhat chain. AI is advisory; approved batch policy controls holds. Physical hardware, public-chain verification and clinical validation are not implemented.
